route: Determine whether any current safety, consent, health, financial, or material relationship decision depends on the information.
Assess whether disclosure has already occurred in substance and whether prior disclosures produced only temporary relief.
Do not give moral absolution or prescribe immediate disclosure.
Use qualified review when rights-relevant disclosure remains genuinely uncertain.
sourceMetadata.defectFound: A simple anti-reassurance route could suppress a real right-to-know; a simple accountability route could prescribe a relief-seeking confession ritual.
sourceMetadata.implementedImprovement: Maps 10 and 11 now distinguish rights-relevant disclosure, likely confession ritual, and unresolved mixed cases.
